## How it was checked

Say which commands you ran and what they printed (see CONTRIBUTING.md).

- [ ] Behaviour change: a test covers it, and `tests/conformance.rs` still passes
- [ ] A change to the on-disk format or the frozen public surface is called out here and in the commit title (release-plz turns the title into the `CHANGELOG.md` entry)
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
